seo.description: Book an Anakata Galápagos yacht expedition — sixteen guests at a time.

hero.sub: Seven or fourteen nights. Saturday to Saturday from San Cristóbal. One expedition yacht, nine suites.

cabins.title: Suite selection
cabins.sub: Choose how many suites, who sleeps where, and exactly which suite on the deck plan. The price follows every choice.
cabins.standardLead: Every metre with a purpose. At 22m², the eight Standard Suites are laid out with nothing missing. The outward wall is glass, edge to edge, so the water is always somewhere in view.
cabins.ownerLead: 44 m² inside, opening onto a 17 m² private terrace with an unobstructed stern and ocean view — a threshold between suite and sea that no other room on board has.

details.title: Reservation details
details.sub: Just the essentials — your booking is obligation-free today. Our team confirms your cabins and answers any question before you pay anything.
details.advisor: I am a Travel Advisor booking on behalf of a client
details.marketing: I would like to receive Anakata expedition news and offers (optional).
details.checkoutMarketing: Anakata may email you news and expedition ideas. You can stop these at any time from the link in those emails. Unticking this box does not withdraw a request already sent. Wording is pending (LEG-002).
details.pngDob: The PNG category estimate uses nationality and the 12-year cutoff. The final category depends on each guest's date of birth.
details.pngAirport: I will pay at SCY airport
details.tctLater: Arrange the TCT with the team later
details.depositWording: The deposit is on cruise charges only; extras and collected fees are due up to {hours} hours before departure.
details.proceed: How would you like to proceed?
details.opt1Body: We hold your suites obligation-free and send the booking to our reservations team. They confirm availability and email your {pct}% deposit link — nothing is charged today.
details.opt2Title: Book now, pay the deposit online
details.opt2Body: Confirm your suites straight away by paying the {pct}% deposit online.

confirm.paidLeadPlain: Thank you — your deposit has been received. Your confirmation and receipt are on their way to {email}.
confirm.paid1: Within {hours} hours our concierge introduces themselves and gathers guest details and preferences.
confirm.paid2: Balance of {amount} is due {days} days before departure — we send a reminder and a secure link.

confirm.paid3: Our concierge curates flights, stays in Quito or Guayaquil, and on-board touches for your party.
